reasons.balancer-c-exposed-mechanism: A is a single, considered self-balancer: matching slotted side plates carry the wheels and frame an orange battery cradle and a board, so the parts are laid out on purpose, while B's white box with a window and its loose-looking spoked wheels look less intentional and less load-carrying.
reasons.balancer-d-product-shell: B is a clearly engineered balancer, with bolted side plates, a board mounted on purpose, a sensor and spoked wheels that all look built for their jobs, while A is the disliked archetype of a soft, rounded pillow box with a visor face and dot eyes.
reasons.balancer-e-hard-surface: B is one crisp hard-surface enclosure, with chamfered edges, bolted panels and a sturdy motor housing that carries well-detailed wheels, so it reads as a single designed object; A's exposed side-plate frame is honest, but its white block with a cut-out window and its thin spoked wheels look less resolved and somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.balancer-f-creature: B is a clearly engineered balancing robot: bolted side plates, a centred body, a board mounted on top and spoked wheels, which reads as one considered, load-carrying structure, while A is a smooth owl with a face and eyes and a wing that looks stuck on, so although it fully commits to its character, it doesn't look engineered.
reasons.balancer-h-free: A is an orderly exposed-mechanism balancer: bolted side plates carry the wheels and frame the boards and battery, so every part reads as load-carrying and placed on purpose, while B is the disliked archetype of a soft, pillow-like rounded box with a visor and dot eyes on wheels.
